description: Add a getProviderName() function to src/llm.js that returns the currently active LLM provider name as a string

contract.raw_request: Add a getProviderName() function to src/llm.js that returns the currently active LLM provider name as a string
contract.goal: Add a function getProviderName() to src/llm.js that returns the currently active LLM provider name as a string.
required_behavior: The function getProviderName() returns the currently active LLM provider name as a string.
The function checks if the LLM provider is active.
constraints: The function must not change the list of available LLM providers.
The function must not change the active LLM provider status.
The function must return a string.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: getProviderName() returns the currently active LLM provider name as a string.
getProviderName() checks if the LLM provider is active.

verification_plan: Run unit tests to verify that getProviderName() returns the correct string for active providers.
